note: Downloads are Hugging Face monthly-download snapshots, not unique users.

artifacts.name: MedPsy-1.7B
artifacts.capability: Compact medical language model for private, on-device use.
artifacts.description: A 1.7B-parameter medical model post-trained with supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning for text-only healthcare reasoning.
artifacts.contribution: I contributed to the research and evaluation, helped write and prepare the technical report, and supported the public release.
results: 62.62 closed-ended medical benchmark average
70.33 HealthBench · 54.33 HealthBench Hard

artifacts.name: MedPsy-1.7B GGUF
artifacts.capability: Quantized MedPsy model for laptops and mobile devices.
artifacts.description: Seven GGUF quantization options provide different quality and memory trade-offs for laptops, smartphones, and other constrained devices.
artifacts.contribution: I worked on the research, evaluation, quantization analysis, and release.
results: Q4_K_M retains 62.16 closed-ended average at 69% smaller than BF16
Q8_0 matches the BF16 benchmark average at 2.16 GB

artifacts.name: MedPsy-4B
artifacts.capability: Higher-capacity medical language model for edge hardware.
artifacts.description: A 4B-parameter medical model with multi-stage post-training for clinical knowledge, expert reasoning, and realistic health scenarios.
artifacts.contribution: I contributed to the research and evaluation, helped write and prepare the technical report, and supported the public release.
results: 70.54 closed-ended medical benchmark average
74.00 HealthBench · 58.00 HealthBench Hard

artifacts.name: MedPsy-4B GGUF
artifacts.capability: Quantized 4B medical model with measured quality retention.
artifacts.description: GGUF weights ranging from near-lossless Q8 to compact IQ3, with benchmark retention reported for each quantization option.
artifacts.contribution: I worked on the research, evaluation, quantization analysis, and release.
results: Q4_K_M retains 69.92 closed-ended average at 69% smaller than BF16
IQ3_M reaches 2.13 GB with a 2.07% relative average-score reduction

artifacts.name: Genesis I Pretrained Model
artifacts.capability: Pretrained checkpoint for evaluating the Genesis I dataset.
artifacts.description: A Qwen3-family base model trained from scratch on approximately 40B Genesis I tokens for dataset evaluation.
artifacts.contribution: I worked on distributed training infrastructure, pretraining ablations, evaluation, and the analysis behind the release.
results: Trained from scratch on the Genesis I corpus
Released as a research checkpoint, not an instruction-tuned flagship model

artifacts.name: Genesis II Combined Checkpoint
artifacts.capability: Checkpoint combining both Genesis II data-generation methods.
artifacts.description: One of three public checkpoints used to compare failure-analysis data, option-level reasoning data, and their combination.
artifacts.contribution: I worked on the data and evaluation pipelines, distributed training, ablations, and release analysis.
results: Pairs both Genesis II data methods in one public checkpoint
Released for ablation work, not as a standalone assistant

artifacts.name: Genesis II Option-Level Checkpoint
artifacts.capability: Checkpoint for evaluating option-level reasoning data.
artifacts.description: A research checkpoint that isolates the option-level reasoning method introduced in Genesis II.
artifacts.contribution: I worked on the data and evaluation pipelines, distributed training, ablations, and release analysis.
results: Tests option-level reasoning without the failure-analysis mix
Released for ablation work, not as a standalone assistant

artifacts.name: Genesis II Failure-Analysis Checkpoint
artifacts.description: A research checkpoint that isolates educational content generated from questions answered incorrectly by a model.
artifacts.contribution: I worked on the data and evaluation pipelines, distributed training, ablations, and release analysis.
results: Tests failure-analysis data without the option-level mix
Released for ablation work, not as a standalone assistant

artifacts.name: QVAC Genesis I
artifacts.capability: Failure-guided educational data for language-model pretraining.
artifacts.description: Synthetic educational content generated from model failures across nine domains and four teaching styles.
artifacts.contribution: I built and operated data-generation and training infrastructure, ran pretraining ablations, and contributed to the release analysis.
results: Nine educational domain configurations
English · CC BY-NC 4.0

artifacts.name: QVAC Genesis II
artifacts.capability: Educational pretraining data with failure analysis and option-level reasoning.
artifacts.description: An expansion of Genesis with ten additional domains and option-level reasoning. Genesis I and II contain 148.37B tokens across 19 domains.
artifacts.contribution: I worked on the data and evaluation pipelines, distributed training, ablations, and analysis behind the release.
results: 19 domains and 148.37B tokens across the combined programme
English · CC BY-NC 4.0

artifacts.name: QVAC Fabric LoRA Adapters
artifacts.capability: LoRA adapters for cross-platform edge fine-tuning.
artifacts.description: Qwen3 and Gemma 3 biomedical adapters trained with a shared workflow across desktop and mobile GPU backends.
artifacts.contribution: I built the original proof of concept, curated the dataset, designed experiments, and validated Vulkan results against PyTorch.
results: Qwen3 0.6B, 1.7B, and 4B reference adapters
Gemma 3 1B and 4B reference adapters

artifacts.name: BitNet b1.58 Edge Artifacts
artifacts.capability: Ternary weights and LoRA adapters for edge fine-tuning.
artifacts.description: Public BitNet weights and biomedical LoRA adapters used for cross-platform fine-tuning and inference through Vulkan and Metal.
artifacts.contribution: I benchmarked the low-bit path, reviewed implementations, evaluated quality, tested mobile and desktop hardware, and contributed to the paper.
results: Up to 13B parameters fine-tuned on iPhone 16
2.1–11.3× edge-GPU inference speedup over CPU in reported tests
